visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the breeding-ground heat circuit, ordinary caretaker work, glassback refusal, public accounting, final cost assignment, and four state-gated outcome families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the locality, claimant introduction, routine choice, routine fold, shortfall reveal, shortage response, public fold, totality threshold, and each ending family. visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt describes a complete drawable frame for a general image model with physical geometry, light, materials, bodies, tools, and staging. Character refs are assembled only for named bodies visible in that frame. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: ecological science-fantasy storybook illustration, fine ink contours over matte gouache, restrained mineral blue, amber, silver, charcoal, and moss-green palette, readable nonhuman silhouettes, tactile living infrastructure, humane workplace detail, cinematic composition designed for interactive-fiction replay.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every rendered prompt from global_style_cue, the selected scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters and groups listed in visible_characters, and triggered state_image_modifiers plus global_branch_image_modifiers. Use a camera-specific Stillwarm Shelf blockout as visual input before high-consistency multi-angle rendering.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one open terrace from several focal distances and carries branch-created body positions, cradle states, and route signals across folds. The embedded draft map owns zones, routes, sightlines, camera slots, and visible state anchors for review.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of Stillwarm Shelf, an open dark-stone breeding-ground terrace on a cool slope beneath an enormous fixed planet in the daytime sky. Three broad shallow ramps descend from the inner terrace edge into low communal nursery hollows. Short trees ring the inner edge, carrying cold blue bioluminescent knots beneath their canopies. Three open heat bays occupy the outer edge; each bay has a low kneeling platform and a flexible arch of pale root braided through dark porous stone. Amber bead-like fungal fruiting bodies mark a separate waste lane across the middle and descend toward a silver-green wetland of thin light-catching mats below. A short broad grazing path rises directly from the wetland to the heat bays. Long-bodied six-limbed Sa'ueia caretakers work at low shelves while infants and infirm adults rest around warm root-and-stone cradles. Broad grazing animals with translucent dorsal plates wait near the heat bays. The view clearly separates routeward outer edge, central work shelf, fungal waste lane, and nurseryward inner ramps.

waiting beside the outer heat bays with dorsal plates exposed
folded at low work shelves or moving on four tall running legs
